description: List every FRC event a team has competed at across all years it has participated. Returns full event records. Use to map a team's complete competition history, generate timelines, or feed per-event aggregations. For a single year see get_team_events.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.

name: get_team_events_all
